_comment: Held-out-32 generalization split (the decisive data-diversity experiment). 26 cf8 levels that replay to the flag at seed 0. Each level TYPE (overworld / athletic / castle) appears in BOTH sets, so the held-out set measures zero-shot transfer to NEW instances of familiar types. cf1 TAS levels (2-2,7-2,7-4,8-4), the 6-3 false-positive, and unsolved 6-2 are excluded. INTEGRITY: holdout levels never enter training or the DAgger oracle.
